bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for the Minitex library information and resource sharing program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATIONS; MINITEX. +]

[+$8,155,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $8,208,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Office of Higher Education for Minitex to serve Minnesota academic and state government libraries by expanding their conventional and virtual access to local, state, regional, national, and international information resources. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for the Minitex library information and resource sharing program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; MINITEX.

$8,155,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $8,208,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Office of Higher Education for Minitex to serve Minnesota academic and state government libraries by expanding their conventional and virtual access to local, state, regional, national, and international information resources.
additions: $8,155,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $8,208,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Office of Higher Education for Minitex to serve Minnesota academic and state government libraries by expanding their conventional and virtual access to local, state, regional, national, and international information resources.
